# Customer Stats

`social-proof/customer-stats` &middot; section-level &middot; category: social-proof

## Purpose

Customer numbers in a row with a heading. A social-proof preset of the stat grid.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stats` | stats |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text | `"Loved by customers"` |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Three customer numbers on the page background color.
- **two-stat**: Two customer numbers. Sets `gridVariant: two-stat`.
- **four-stat**: Four customer numbers. Sets `gridVariant: four-stat`.
- **light**: On the surface color. Sets `background: @colors.surface`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `gridVariant` | one of `default`, `two-stat`, `four-stat`, `tinted` | `"default"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.background"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Each row is a table with exact widths. | Two per row on phones uses a media query. Non-Google Gmail accounts show the desktop layout. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('social-proof/customer-stats', {
  "heading": "Loved by customers",
  "stats": [
    {
      "value": "10,000+",
      "label": "Customers"
    },
    {
      "value": "4.9",
      "label": "Average rating"
    },
    {
      "value": "92%",
      "label": "Order again"
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "social-proof/customer-stats",
  "data": {
    "heading": "Loved by customers",
    "stats": [
      {
        "value": "10,000+",
        "label": "Customers"
      },
      {
        "value": "4.9",
        "label": "Average rating"
      },
      {
        "value": "92%",
        "label": "Order again"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
